nodes.name: Internal Subworkflow Trigger
nodes.notes: P1-L10 internal entry. Invoked in-tenant by the Mini App gateway. No public URL, no transport secret. Receives the wrapper { submission_key, envelope }.

nodes.name: Internal Auth Entry
nodes.notes: F1 marker + F2 wrapper proof. The marker is on THIS node because internalRouteProven() reads THIS node. Never reads provenance from the caller.

nodes.name: IF Internal Fault
nodes.notes: F3. TRUE = trusted internal call with unusable controls -> fail closed, zero Pipeline, zero receipt writes, never the public flow.

nodes.name: Internal Result (Fault)
nodes.notes: F3/F4 terminal. Reachable only from the internal fault gate.

nodes.name: Internal Envelope Unwrap
nodes.notes: F10. Emits the webhook request shape { headers, body }. submission_key never enters the body.

nodes.name: Internal Flag
nodes.notes: Passes Validate Payload output through untouched and adds __internal for the terminal gates.

nodes.name: Correlation Guard
nodes.notes: F2. Internal correlation id must equal Normalize request_id, or fail closed before the claim.

nodes.name: IF Correlation OK
nodes.notes: FALSE = the receipt correlation and the pipeline request_id disagree. Never silently pick one.

nodes.name: Internal Result (Correlation)
nodes.notes: F2 terminal. Correlation mismatch, fail closed before READY -> IN_FLIGHT.

nodes.name: Receipt Gate
nodes.notes: Receipt branch requires INTERNAL provenance + exact key + server correlation id. Public path bypasses the whole branch and reveals nothing about key existence.

nodes.name: IF Receipt Fault
nodes.notes: F3 second gate. TRUE = trusted but receipt controls unusable -> fail closed, never public.

nodes.name: IF Receipt Required
nodes.notes: TRUE -> receipt critical section. FALSE -> public/ordinary path, receipt untouched.

nodes.name: Receipt Exact Read
nodes.notes: Exact-key read. alwaysOutputData so an ABSENT receipt still reaches the verdict node instead of silently skipping the rest of the branch (P4 zero-item semantics).

nodes.name: Receipt Read Verdict
nodes.notes: Absence resolves to a broken invariant, never to "safe to proceed".

nodes.name: IF Receipt Claimable
nodes.notes: Only a single READY row for the exact key may proceed.

nodes.name: IF Receipt Is Retry
nodes.notes: F6. TRUE = dedup already resolved this to an existing Pipeline row and NO write will occur, so the receipt is settled READY -> COMMITTED directly. No IN_FLIGHT window is created for a submission that provably writes nothing.

nodes.name: Receipt Retry Settlement
nodes.notes: F6 READY -> COMMITTED in one CAS. No Pipeline write occurs on this branch, so there is no ambiguous window to protect and no IN_FLIGHT state is created. canonical_lead_id is the DEDUP-SELECTED existing lead, matching Respond Retry exactly.

nodes.name: Retry Settlement Verdict
nodes.notes: F6. A lost settlement CAS fails closed; it never reports ordinary success.

nodes.name: IF Retry Settled
nodes.notes: Only exactly one settled row permits the retry success return.

nodes.name: Internal Result (Retry)
nodes.notes: F4/F5 terminal. Returns the SAME canonical lead id that the public Respond Retry returns.

nodes.name: Receipt Claim
nodes.notes: READY -> IN_FLIGHT CAS for the write-bearing branches. alwaysOutputData:true is LOAD-BEARING: P4 proved a zero-match returns main[0]===[] and skips every downstream node, so without it the fail-closed branch could never run. Sets correlation_id (P1-L9).

nodes.name: Claim Verdict
nodes.notes: Converts item presence into an explicit count. The synthetic empty item is ZERO, never success.

nodes.name: IF Claim Won
nodes.notes: THE gate. Only updated_rows === 1 reaches Pipeline. 0, >1 and unreadable all fail closed.

nodes.name: Internal Result (Unresolved)
nodes.notes: F4 terminal. Reached when a receipt read, claim, settlement or commit CAS did not return exactly one row. NO Pipeline node is reachable from here. Not a RespondToWebhook: the internal path must never depend on one.

nodes.name: IF Internal (New)
nodes.notes: F4/§6. TRUE = internal: settle the receipt and return the internal contract. FALSE = public: respond through the existing webhook node, receipt table untouched.

nodes.name: Receipt Commit (New)
nodes.notes: IN_FLIGHT -> COMMITTED CAS. correlation_id is NOT in the set: it was written by the winning claim and is immutable (P1-L9). canonical_lead_id matches the public response for this branch exactly.

nodes.name: Commit Verdict (New)
nodes.notes: Pipeline succeeded but commit CAS !== 1 must NOT report ordinary success.

nodes.name: IF Committed (New)
nodes.notes: Only exactly one committed row permits the success return.

nodes.name: Internal Result (New)
nodes.notes: F4/F5 terminal. Returns the SAME canonical values the public response for this branch returns.

nodes.name: IF Internal (Merge)
nodes.notes: F4/§6. TRUE = internal: settle the receipt and return the internal contract. FALSE = public: respond through the existing webhook node, receipt table untouched.

nodes.name: Receipt Commit (Merge)
nodes.notes: IN_FLIGHT -> COMMITTED CAS. correlation_id is NOT in the set: it was written by the winning claim and is immutable (P1-L9). canonical_lead_id matches the public response for this branch exactly.

nodes.name: Commit Verdict (Merge)
nodes.notes: Pipeline succeeded but commit CAS !== 1 must NOT report ordinary success.

nodes.name: IF Committed (Merge)
nodes.notes: Only exactly one committed row permits the success return.

nodes.name: Internal Result (Merge)
nodes.notes: F4/F5 terminal. Returns the SAME canonical values the public response for this branch returns.

nodes.name: IF Internal (Retry)
nodes.notes: F4 structural guarantee. Internal retries are normally diverted at IF Receipt Is Retry; this catches any internal call that still reaches the ordinary retry edge.

nodes.name: IF Internal (Invalid)
nodes.notes: F4. TRUE = internal: return the internal contract. FALSE = public: existing webhook response.

nodes.name: Internal Result (Invalid)
nodes.notes: F4 terminal for the internal path. Never a RespondToWebhook.

nodes.name: IF Internal (Infra)
nodes.notes: F4. TRUE = internal: return the internal contract. FALSE = public: existing webhook response.

nodes.name: Internal Result (Infra)
nodes.notes: F4 terminal for the internal path. Never a RespondToWebhook.

nodes.name: IF Internal (PipelineFailed)
nodes.notes: F4. TRUE = internal: return the internal contract. FALSE = public: existing webhook response.

nodes.name: Internal Result (PipelineFailed)
nodes.notes: F4 terminal for the internal path. Never a RespondToWebhook.

nodes.name: IF Internal (MergeFailed)
nodes.notes: F4. TRUE = internal: return the internal contract. FALSE = public: existing webhook response.

nodes.name: Internal Result (MergeFailed)
nodes.notes: F4 terminal for the internal path. Never a RespondToWebhook.
